items.prompt: Cue the setup for Sample Move A.
items.answer: Both hands on the front rail, both feet on the sliding deck
items.explanation: Give hands first, then feet, so the client can build the position in order.

citations.quote: both hands on the front rail and both feet on the sliding deck

items.prompt: What is the pace of Sample Move A?
items.answer: Four counts out, four counts back
items.explanation: Sample Move A is a slow move with an even count each way.

citations.quote: four counts out and four counts back

items.prompt: A client finds Sample Move A too hard. What do you offer?
items.answer: Shorten the range and keep one knee down
items.explanation: The easier option keeps the same move but asks less of the body.

citations.quote: shorten the range and keep one knee down
